LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: Arc Record Detail By Field Set
LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders a record detail section from an SObject field set, styled like Arc Record Detail.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: SObject API Name
property.description: API name of the object, e.g. Account

property.name: fieldSetApiName
property.label: Field Set API Name
property.description: Developer name of the field set to render

property.name: sectionTitle
property.label: Section Title
property.description: Optional title shown above the field list

property.name: enableEditing
property.label: Enable Editing
property.description: When enabled, users can edit fields and save changes for this section.
